facts.fact: 第一声惨叫不是 Sterling，他松了口气
facts.anchor: The voice was too rough to belong to Sterling, and relief washed over Winter

facts.fact: 她手无武器，他却感到不安
facts.anchor: So why did apprehension nudge at him

facts.fact: 围场数十年未用（父亲在城堡附近建了更大的）
facts.anchor: This place hadn’t been used in decades

facts.fact: 两囚犯袭击他，他折断女方手臂、夺匕首割喉
facts.anchor: grabbed the woman’s arm, and snapped it

facts.fact: 他把匕首掷入逃走的男犯后背
facts.anchor: The dagger flew from his hand, spinning over itself in an expert arch

facts.fact: 他闻到 Sterling 的气味，也闻到不该在场的母狼
facts.anchor: The faintest hint of Sterling but also … wolf

facts.fact: 他撞开扑在 Sterling 身上的 Talia
facts.anchor: His shoulder slammed into Talia’s side

facts.fact: 交配仪式前夜，Talia 与他人上床
facts.anchor: when his perfect mate had been fucking someone else. The night before their mating ceremony

facts.fact: 他警告 Talia：父亲一死她就无容身之地
facts.anchor: The moment my father is dead, your place in this pack is gone

facts.fact: Talia 指出最后两人是他杀的——她因此“赢了”
facts.anchor: You killed the last two. I smell them on you
